payload.posture: Read Genesis 41:25–36 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states joseph joins the dreams as one divine disclosure, distinguishes abundance from famine, and proposes measured storage under a discerning overseer. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
